## Instructions

1. Butter the bread, cube it into a dish.
2. Scatter raisins over.
3. Beat eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon; pour over.
4. Bake at 350°F, 1 hour.

## Notes

From the church bazaar table.
